evidence.quote: We are happy to announce that the Fair Play Follow Up feature is now live.

entities.label: High ping queue
entities.scope: Blood Testament Chapter 3 · Europe 임시 시험

evidence.quote:
High-Ping Queue Test
One of THE most requested topics is regarding High-Ping Matchmaking. We are happy to report that we will be running a test on the European servers during Chapter 3.

assertions.subject: follow
assertions.statement: 공식 글은 Fair Play Follow Up 서비스가 당시 개시됐다고 발표했다.

evidence.quote: We are happy to announce that the Fair Play Follow Up feature is now live.

assertions.subject: follow
assertions.statement: 공식 설명에 따르면 치팅으로 신고한 플레이어가 제재되면 조치 알림을 받는다.

evidence.quote: - If you reported them for cheating, you will get notified that we have taken action against the cheater

assertions.subject: follow
assertions.value: 특정 기간 내 제재 대상에게 사망한 이용자
assertions.statement: 공식 설명은 제재된 플레이어에게 특정 기간 내 사망한 사람들에게 잠재적 피해 보상을 지급한다고 설명한다.

evidence.quote: - If you were killed by them, you will get compensation, along with all the people who were killed within a specific timeframe, for potentially being the victim of a cheater.

assertions.subject: follow
assertions.statement: 공식 글은 보상액을 평균 장비와 헌터 비용을 합산하고 올림한 1000 Hunt Dollars로 설명한다.

evidence.quote: The compensation will be 1000 Hunt Dollars, which was calculated by adding the average loadout and Hunter cost, and rounding it up.

assertions.subject: follow
assertions.statement: 보상 수령은 해당 교전에서 핵이 사용됐음을 뜻하지 않으며 잠재적 피해자를 넓게 보상한다는 공식 설명이다.

evidence.quote: This said, receiving compensation doesn't mean that you were killed by someone who used a hack, but rather that we compensate everybody who was potentially affected.

assertions.subject: follow
assertions.statement: 공식 글은 피드백에 따라 시스템과 보상을 조정할 계획이라고 밝혔다.

evidence.quote: This is a first step, and we plan to adjust the system and compensation as we receive your feedback.

assertions.subject: ping
assertions.statement: 공식 글은 High-Ping Queue 시험을 Chapter 3 기간의 유럽 서버로 한정해 안내한다.

evidence.quote: We are happy to report that we will be running a test on the European servers during Chapter 3.

assertions.subject: ping
assertions.statement: 공식 설명은 125ms 초과 플레이어를 분리하는 시험이며 기준값은 시험 중 바뀔 수 있다고 명시한다.

evidence.quote: The objective is to experiment with the ways we separate players with a ping above 125 ms (this value is subject to change during the test) from regular players to reduce their exposure to high-latency gameplay.

assertions.subject: ping
assertions.value: 일정 시간 미매칭 시 일반 매치 선택
assertions.statement: 공식 설명은 고핑 큐에서 일정 시간 매치를 찾지 못하면 일반 매치를 찾는 선택권을 제공한다.

evidence.quote: After a set period, if no match is found in the high ping queue, you will have the option to find a “normal" match.

assertions.subject: ping
assertions.value: 시험 시작 시 팀 최고 핑 기준
assertions.statement: 공식 글은 시험 시작 시 팀 내 가장 높은 핑으로 고핑 큐 진입을 판단한다고 설명한다.

evidence.quote: At the start of the test, we will use the highest ping of the team to decide if they'll enter the high ping matchmaking queue.
